name: id
description: The unique identifier of the Publisher action record.

name: approver_id
description: The identifier of the Publisher user who approved the action, where the action records an approval.

name: approved_timestamp
description: The date and time when the approval was recorded, where the action records an approval.

name: comment_character
description: The free-text comment or message associated with the workflow action, where provided.

name: comment_sanitized
description: Comment-sanitisation flag. All observed values in the table are FALSE.

name: request_type
description: The type of Publisher workflow action recorded. Observed values cover assignment, review, fact checking, amendment requests, notes, version creation, scheduling, publishing and archiving.

name: request_details
description: For the request_type called schedule_for_publishing, the JSON contains a key-value pair of the words ‘scheduled_time’ and the scheduled publication time; other actions contain an empty JSON object.

name: requester_name
description: Only populated on receive_fact_check actions. The name of the person who requested the fact check.

name: email_address
description: Only populated for send_fact_check and fact_check_requested actions. The email address identifies the recipient/s of the fact-check request.

name: customised_message
description: Only populated for send_fact_check and fact_check_requested actions. The message contains the content and instructions sent with that request.

name: mongo_id
description: The identifier of the corresponding action record in Publisher’s former MongoDB database, retained to correlate migrated action records with their PostgreSQL records. This field is null where no former MongoDB action identifier is recorded.

name: create_at
description: The date and time when the Publisher action record was created.

name: updated_at
description: The date and time when the Publisher action record was last updated.

name: edition_id
description: The identifier of the Publisher edition to which the action relates. This joins to id in govuk-knowledge-graph.publisher.editions

name: requester_id
description: The identifier of the Publisher user who initiated the workflow action or request, where recorded.

name: recipient_id
description: Only populated for the request_type ‘assign’. The identifier of the Publisher user to whom the edition was assigned.
